summary: First run of backend API tests for ENERED fintech platform. 26/26 tests PASSED after fixing 1 MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in POST /api/users. Covered: auth (login/me/logout/forgot-password), dashboard KPIs + alerts, consumptions with tenant isolation, empresas, Users CRUD, Invoices with role-based access, Control requests role gating, Courses LMS with submit scoring, and CSV/Excel admin upload.
action_items: No pending actions — backend is green. Main agent can proceed with frontend integration/UI work.
Consider: seed_demo_data does NOT re-hash admin password if ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (only inserts if absent). Not idempotent for rotations — acceptable for demo but worth noting.
Consider: verify_password swallows all exceptions silently (returns False). Fine for auth safety but masks configuration errors.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by T1: POST /api/users returned 500 due to Mongo's _id ObjectId being serialized. Added `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert_one in server.py. All other create endpoints (invoices/control-requests/courses) already handle this correctly.

server.py is ~917 lines and mixes auth, models, endpoints, seed logic — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Recommend modularising into routers (auth, users, consumptions, invoices, control, courses, admin) plus a separate seed module.

CORS is configured at `app` level AFTER `app.include_router(api)` and uses `FRONTEND_URL` env var. Currently FRONTEND_URL in backend/.env (`9ceebdef-...preview.emergentagent.com`) does NOT match the actual frontend URL in frontend/.env (`enered-insight.preview.emergentagent.com`). Cookie-based auth from browser will fail CORS with credentials; Bearer token fallback works. Should either align URLs or use a wildcard-safe regex.
No brute-force / rate-limit / account lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook asks for lockout after 5 fails. Not implemented.
JWT_SECRET is present and strong. bcrypt hash produced via bcrypt.gensalt() -> format $2b$ ✓.
DELETE /api/admin/consumptions wipes ALL consumption rows with no confirmation/backup — destructive, consider soft-delete or require explicit empresa.
Dashboard endpoints load up to 100 000 rows into memory for aggregation — acceptable at current seed volume (~451 rows) but should move to Mongo aggregation pipeline for scale.
`/api/courses/{cid}/submit` divides by `len(preguntas) if preguntas else 1` and computes 0/1=0 when no questions — edge case handled but silently awards 0% rather than rejecting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is pytest-based and idempotent (unique emails via uuid). Uses Authorization: Bearer header because httpOnly cookies are samesite=none/secure=true and work for browsers but the test client also supports them. One fix applied to server.py (create_user _id removal). If frontend testing is requested next, verify CORS FRONTEND_URL alignment — currently mismatched between backend/.env and frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: POST /api/users → 500. Root cause: Motor's insert_one mutates the input dict by adding `_id` (bson.ObjectId). The endpoint then returned the same dict to FastAPI, which cannot JSON-serialize ObjectId -> raised ValueError('ObjectId is not iterable'). Reproduction: authenticated POST to /api/users with valid payload. Mitigation applied: `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert_one, mirroring the pattern used in create_invoice/create_control/create_course.
